entries.en:
Jihli Aliapoh tells you of her vision which inspired the designs for this year's Hatching-tide eggs. However, because the celebration requires eggs, both great and small, in seemingly unreasonable quantities, the frequent delivery of these goods has caught the eye of local spriggans. Ever wont to procure all things small and round, they now work to make all the eggs their own, stealing the Archon eggs in the process.

Maisenta of Black Rabbit Traders dispatched men to retrieve two of the eggs, which have since been delivered to the Yellow Serpent Gate. With spriggans now forcing their way into Gridania, however, she can spare no one to bring them further into town. Jihli implores you to retrieve the eggs, that they may serve as vessels for the Twelve Archons.

Before you set off to retrieve them, however, she offers you a warning: the Archon eggs may only be touched by one who bears their mark. In order to transport both eggs to a safe location in a timely manner, join forces with another adventurer. One of you must wear a pristine egg cap, the other a vibrant egg cap. When you have found a comrade-in-arms, and are both wearing an appropriate cap, speak with Augustiniel at the Yellow Serpent Gate.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

Jihli Aliapoh vous parle de sa récente vision qui lui a inspiré l'organisation de la chasse aux Prœufs de cette année. Cependant, vu la quantité astronomique d'œufs de toutes tailles, Maisenta du Lièvre noir a dû recourir à l'aide des spriggans pour les rassembler. À son grand désarroi, ceux-ci ont décidé de se les approprier. Jihli Aliapoh aimerait donc que vous récupériez les œufs devant servir de réceptacles aux Preux. Elle vous met en garde, cependant : les Prœufs ne peuvent être touchés que par quelqu'un qui porte leur marque. Afin de les mener en lieu sûr au plus vite, faites-vous aider par un camarade. Équipez-vous respectivement d' et d', puis allez parler à Augustiniel, à la porte de la Vipère jaune.

entries.en: You have arrived at the Yellow Serpent Gate, relieved to find Augustiniel and the Archon eggs safe and sound. Although ill equipped to deliver the eggs to Jihli Aliapoh himself, Augustiniel is confident that you and your friend can outwit the spriggans that have managed to find their way into town. Together with your comrade, don your respective caps to transport the pristine Archon egg and vibrant Archon egg to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
entries.fr: Augustiniel et les Prœufs se portent bien. Même si l'acheminement de ces derniers depuis la futaie des Murmures s'est effectué sans encombre, Augustiniel est seul et ne peut se permettre de les laisser sans surveillance. Avec l'aide de votre camarade, transportez  et  jusqu'à l'amphithéâtre de Mih Khetto.

entries.en: Averting the fuzzy grasp of the spriggans, you have safely transported your Archon egg to its rightful place at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre. Trust your faithful companion to have done the same, and speak with Jihli Aliapoh to inform her of the good news.
entries.fr: Parvenant à échapper aux pattes griffues des spriggans, votre camarade et vous avez réussi à acheminer les Prœufs jusqu'à l'amphithéâtre de Mih Khetto. Faites part à Jihli Aliapoh de la bonne nouvelle.

entries.en: Jihli Aliapoh is beside herself with joy to hear that two of the Archon eggs have been returned. Thanks to your selfless actions, this year's Hatching-tide may still yet prove to be a success. Until all of the eggs have been retrieved, however, it might be best to stay close to Jihli in case your talents are needed once more.

entries.en: I dreamt of a resplendent ring of eggs, shining with an intensity that would inspire jealousy from the stars. From within this ring arose a figure bathed in light. Although I could not clearly discern who it was, I knew it was one of the heroes of yore for whom I have waited all these years.
entries.fr: Dans mon rêve, j'ai vu un cercle formé d'œufs. Ils brillaient tellement que les étoiles en auraient rougi de jalousie. Dans ce cercle se trouvait une silhouette baignée de lumière. Je n'ai pas pu discerrrner son visage, mais je sais qu'il s'agissait de l'un des héros que j'attends depuis tant d'années.

entries.en: As you can imagine, a great number of eggs have been transported back and forth between the three city-states in preparation for Hatching-tide. The spriggans─with their insatiable need for small, ovoid objects─have taken notice, and are stealing any eggs they can find, including the Archon eggs.

entries.en: Well, two of the eggs were recovered in Treespeak not long ago and were carried to the Yellow Serpent Gate. Unsurprisingly, however, the spriggans who stole the eggs in the first place immediately gave chase, and have since infiltrated Gridania. I can only assume they mean to take them back.

entries.en: If you'd help us, we need you to retrieve a pristine and a vibrant Archon egg, so make sure you're equipped with the right headgear. If you're lacking the proper cap, you can purchase one from the Dreamers.
entries.fr: Les œufs dont tu devras te charger sont les réceptacles des Preux, alors prépare-toi bien. Si tu n'as pas le bon couvrœuf, adresse-toi à l'une des Rêveuses. Quant aux spriggans encore dans le coin, je crois que j'ai une petite idée.
entries.ja:
今回、運び込んだのは「プレーン」と「カモ」の2種類です。
エッグキャップは全部で5種類。
各都市のエッグドリーマーが販売していますわ。

entries.en: As for the spriggans that still linger here in Gridania, I have an idea. Because you may only carry the egg which bears the pattern of your cap, attempting to carry both will make you an easy target for the spriggans.
entries.fr: Si tu transportes les deux Prœufs ornés de la même marque que ton couvrœuf, tu seras une proie facile pour les spriggans.

一度に運べば、妨害を分散できますから、
まずは、仲間をひとり探してください。

entries.en: Fortune has smiled upon me this day, to have encountered such an exceptional adventurer! I bid you safe travels till fate should choose we cross paths once more. May the Archons of yore bless you and keep you.
entries.fr: La chance m'a sourrri aujourd'hui, car je t'ai rencontré. Lorsque nous aurons trouvé le prochain réceptacle, j'espère que nous pourrons compter sur ton aide.
entries.ja:
だから、どんどんスプリガンをやっつけて！
集めた飾りタマゴは、各都市のエッグドリーマーに届けてね！
エグ、エグ、エグル、エッグルルルゥ～ッ♪
